name: Java
description: Java on the OpenJDK HotSpot JVM (Eclipse Temurin builds): bytecode with tiered JIT compilation and a generational, mostly concurrent garbage collector.

variants.name: java
variants.description: Default JVM flags (G1 garbage collector). Compile time is not measured; the JIT warm-up is.

variants.name: java -XX:+UseParallelGC
variants.description: Throughput-oriented collector with less barrier overhead than G1.
